# librashader

`librashader.h` is the unmodified public C header from
[librashader v0.12.0](https://github.com/SnowflakePowered/librashader/tree/librashader-v0.12.0).
It is MIT licensed; its complete notice is retained in the header.

The optional runtime is downloaded separately and is not part of this source
tree. Upstream offers its C API/runtime under `MPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-only`.
Use the MPL-2.0 option when redistributing it with this project, retain its
notices, and provide the corresponding covered source. The upstream MPL text
is retained in `LICENSE.MPL-2.0`.

Pinned source:
https://github.com/SnowflakePowered/librashader/archive/refs/tags/librashader-v0.12.0.tar.gz

The dependency fetcher's manifest records the exact archive, hashes and source
location. Binary packaging must include the runtime's applicable dependency
notices and source obligations; this change does not update release packages.
User-selected shader packs have their own licenses and remain external assets.
